_note: FICTIONAL customer Larkfield Mutual. Invented for the chapter.
title: Serve the claims summariser from self-hosted open-weight models on a dedicated on-premises GPU pool
context: Claim data contains personal information and must stay on premises. The team has three platform engineers and no GPU operations history. The pilot is due in 16 weeks and approval takes 10 weeks. Peak load is about six times the average.
drivers: Small team with no GPU experience
Budget is a range, not a fixed number

options.name: Self-hosted on a managed GPU Kubernetes service
cons: Needs a region that meets residency
Team still owns serving and monitoring

options.name: Self-hosted on customer-owned hardware
cons: Team must learn GPU failure handling
Capacity fixed against a peak six times the average

consequences: Order lead time starts the clock before the PoC ends, so the PoC must run on rented capacity first
A GPU operations training and runbook workstream is added to the plan
Peak handling needs a queue or degraded mode, to be agreed with the business
revisit_when: The PoC misses a must criterion
